# Icons8 Liquid Glass icons

Halo uses nine selected SVG React components from the [Icons8 Liquid Glass Icons repository](https://github.com/icons8/liquid-glass-icons): `combo-chart`, `search`, `folder-invoices`, `picture`, `synchronize`, `settings`, `puzzle`, `info`, and `home`.

The upstream repository is licensed under MIT. Its full license text is preserved beside these files and in the deployed `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`. The icons are used as source SVG components; app tint, hover bloom, and layout styling are Halo-specific. No Icons8 Glassmorphism catalog/stock downloads are included.
